findings.description: Product list prices change on every page load (for example Sauce Labs Backpack shows $17.62, $96.69, $87.25 and $24.63 on successive loads) and never match the real price, which is $29.99 on the product detail page and in the cart.
repro: Sign in as customer-11fa
Note the Sauce Labs Backpack price on /inventory.html
Reload the page several times: the price changes on each load
Open the Backpack detail page: it shows $29.99
Add the Backpack to the cart and open the cart: it shows $29.99

findings.description: Prices with one decimal digit are shown without the second digit, e.g. "$5.7", "$74.3" and "$58.2" instead of "$5.70", "$74.30" and "$58.20". Cart, detail and checkout pages always show two decimals.
repro: Sign in as customer-11fa
Reload /inventory.html until a price with a single decimal digit appears, such as $74.3
Compare with the cart or the checkout overview, which show two decimals

findings.description: Product names in the grid are aligned inconsistently: Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt and Sauce Labs Fleece Jacket are right-aligned (computed text-align: right) while the other product names are left-aligned, so their titles sit indented in their cards at 1280 px and at 360 px.
repro: Sign in as customer-11fa
Open /inventory.html at 1280 px
Compare Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt (indented to the right) with Sauce Labs Backpack (flush left)

findings.description: The Add to cart button of the Test.allTheThings() T-Shirt (Red) card overflows the card's right border at 1280 px and at 360 px, so it sticks out past the card edge.
repro: Sign in as customer-11fa
Open /inventory.html at 1280 px wide
Look at the Test.allTheThings() T-Shirt (Red) card: its Add to cart button extends past the card border
Repeat at 360 px wide: the same button runs past the card edge

findings.description: Keyboard focus is not visible: when Tab moves focus to the Add to cart buttons, product links and the sort dropdown, no focus ring or other visible change appears (computed outline-style is none and box-shadow is none), so keyboard users cannot see where they are.
repro: Sign in as customer-11fa on /inventory.html at 1280 px
Press Tab until focus reaches the Add to cart button of Sauce Labs Bike Light
Observe that the button looks the same as when unfocused and no focus indicator is drawn
Repeat for the sort dropdown and the product title links

findings.description: The shopping cart icon in the header sits below the header bar, on the border between the header and the Products sub-bar, instead of being vertically centred in the header. The same misplacement appears on the checkout pages.
repro: Sign in as customer-11fa
Open /inventory.html at 1280 px
The cart icon sits about 25 px lower than the Swag Labs title and overlaps the header border
Open checkout: the same icon position is shown

notes: Tested at 1280 px and 360 px with Chromium, mouse and keyboard. Checked: login, inventory, sort menu, burger menu at both widths, detail page, cart, checkout step one and overview (totals add up: 29.99 + tax 2.40 = 32.39). Not tested: full checkout completion, the login page as a11y deeper audit (no axe-core available), colour contrast measurements, screen reader behaviour, and phone touch targets in detail.
